tests.contains: describe('HopX real-factory lifecycle contract (native SDK boundary)', () => {

claims: Named native-only-mocked tests validate required stdout/stderr strings and integer native exit_code, preserving valid nonzero/negative statuses and completed zero.

Named tests reject caught compatibility result zero and malformed metadata; complete nonzero error.result compatibility remains supported without claiming native SDK authority for that synthetic path.

Named lifecycle regressions classify only actual APIError404 plus server SANDBOX_NOT_FOUND, preserve original ambiguous failures, and validate native sandbox IDs. Actual exported HTTPClient tests use an in-process Axios adapter to prove reachable scoped errors and heuristic rewrites without network.
limitations: Only named local command and lifecycle regression cases are covered; live native behavior, other operations and full capability coverage remain unverified.
No clean dependency installation or native-provider execution was performed; the existing installed dependency store was reused.
Installed native SDK contracts were inspected at the recorded version; compatibility throughout the declared dependency range is unverified.
Ordinary native errors retain the existing synthetic exit127 policy; protocol rejection does not itself guarantee remote cleanup or process-tree reaping.
The inspected native SDK has no error.result contract; those tests cover legacy compatibility only and cannot establish a completed successful command after an exception.
Shell env/cwd quoting, timeout policy and broader capability contracts remain outside these tests.

Destroy still requires connect: paused boxes may resume/refresh, stopped boxes refuse connection. Native heuristics can rewrite true missing responses into ambiguous Expired/FileNotFound errors; profile remains cleanup-blocked.
command: pnpm --filter @computesdk/hopx --fail-if-no-match exec vitest run src/__tests__/command-contract.test.ts src/__tests__/lifecycle-contract.test.ts --maxWorkers=1 --minWorkers=1
scope: Historical revision-specific local regression evidence, not all-capability or current/future-tree native certification.
